title: Core Set 2021 Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.
Some protection requires a bit of finesse.
The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.
He will be your loyal champion, and his pack your protectors. All he asks for is a full belly, a spot by the fire, and all the love in your heart.
"All are welcome in the angels' light."
"There is no age at which you stop learning."
"What is this that is neither future nor past?"
The Blessed Sleep doesn't come easily to a mind chained by regrets.
"Fine, you know more than me. But do you have to be such a show-off about it?" —Chandra Nalaar, to Teferi
As blood touched the empty page, it formed words that seared themselves into the wizard's mind.
"Defy me and I will burn the flesh from your bones. Betray me and I will steal the breath from your lungs."
The purple banner of the House of Vess is a symbol of death wherever it's flown.
"Oh, don't be so dramatic. When your eyes bleed, and your brain leaks out your ears, then we'll talk about lost sanity." —Braids, dementia summoner
"Through the blood of the wicked, we shall be redeemed. Let us pray."
paragraphs.card: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

paragraphs.text: "You hit like a kobold!"
"Your eyes aren't playing tricks on you. I am."
"One day the mountain's fire will rise up to burn away our chains and end this age of oppression." —*The Molten Prophecy*
"I'd like to introduce you to the new and improved me."
Seeing it coming a mile away is little comfort if you can't get out of range in time.
"I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."
Dogs beg. Cats lay claim.
"Wherever the strong would harm the weak, I will be there." —Ajani Goldmane
"Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."
The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.
In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.
It spins its web throughout the undercity, strange growths sprouting in its wake.
Visitors marvel at its design, unaware of the other world that inspired it.
"No owners allowed." —Sanctuary sign
From here, the path to anywhere may be found.
